meta.title: Reducir cláusulas con precisión
meta.goal: Puedes condensar cláusulas relativas y adverbiales sin perder la relación lógica ni crear modificadores ambiguos.

cards.title: Comprime información compartida
cards.lede: Una cláusula participial elimina palabras previsibles cuando su sujeto se recupera con claridad.

columns.label: Cláusula completa
examples: The applicants who were selected will receive an email.
Because she knew the system, Priya led the demo.

columns.label: Cláusula reducida
columns.rule: Usa -ing, participio pasado o having + participio.
examples: The applicants selected will receive an email.
Knowing the system, Priya led the demo.

cards.title: -ing para sentido activo; participio para pasivo
cards.lede: La relación del sustantivo con la acción determina la forma reducida.

rows.value: Customers waiting outside were offered coffee.
The data collected in May revealed a pattern.
Concerned about the delay, the manager called the vendor.
Employees interested in the role should apply by Friday.

cards.title: Having + participio marca anterioridad
cards.lede: Usa la forma perfecta cuando necesitas dejar claro que una acción terminó antes de la principal.

columns.label: Simultánea o causa inmediata
examples: Noticing the error, I stopped the upload.
Walking into the room, she heard applause.

columns.label: Anterior y completada
examples: Having reviewed the contract, I signed it.
Having been warned, they changed course.

cards.title: La puntuación no sustituye el significado
cards.lede: La cláusula reducida puede expresar tiempo, causa, condición o resultado; el contexto debe hacerlo inequívoco.

rows.value: Leaving the office, I ran into Sam. (= as I was leaving)
Recognizing the risk, the board postponed the vote. (= because it recognized)
Handled carefully, the device should last for years. (= if it is handled)
The storm damaged several lines, leaving thousands without power.

cards.title: Evita el modificador colgante
cards.lede: El sujeto implícito de la cláusula inicial debe ser el sujeto de la cláusula principal.

lines.text: Driving to work, the rain started.
Driving to work, I noticed that it had started to rain.
After reviewing the numbers, the recommendation was obvious.
After reviewing the numbers, we found the recommendation obvious.

cards.title: Reduce solo cuando mejora el texto
cards.lede: La compresión funciona en informes y narraciones, pero una cláusula completa puede ser más clara.

rows.value: Subraya los sujetos de ambas cláusulas y confirma que coinciden.
Usa -ing si el sujeto actúa; participio pasado si recibe la acción.
Usa having + participio solo si el orden necesita énfasis.
Because the report was revised after the audit, it now includes the missing figures. → Revised after the audit, the report now includes the missing figures.

tip.label: Criterio editorial
tip.body: Si el lector puede atribuir la acción al sujeto equivocado, conserva la cláusula completa.

quiz.q: Choose the correct reduction: The files that were deleted cannot be recovered.
options: The files deleting cannot be recovered.
The files deleted cannot be recovered.
Deleting the files cannot be recovered.
quiz.explain: Files recibe la acción, por eso corresponde el participio pasado deleted.

quiz.q: Which sentence has a dangling modifier?
options: Having checked the address, Lena mailed the package.
Having checked the address, the package was mailed.
quiz.explain: El sujeto gramatical package no pudo comprobar la dirección.

quiz.q: ¿Qué forma enfatiza que la revisión terminó antes de la decisión?
options: Reviewing the evidence, we made a decision.
Having reviewed the evidence, we made a decision.
quiz.explain: Having reviewed marca explícitamente anterioridad completada.

quiz.q: Reduce without changing voice: People living nearby opposed the plan.
options: People who live nearby opposed the plan.
People who were lived nearby opposed the plan.
quiz.explain: Living tiene sentido activo y equivale a who live.
